author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Iran has expanded retaliatory strikes across Gulf countries that host United States military bases, raising fears of a wider regional escalation.
In Bahrain, authorities say an Iranian attack caused a fire and material damage at an oil facility in Ma’amir, while a separate drone strike on Sitra Island injured at least 32 people, including children.
Recent days have also seen damage to a desalination plant and injuries from falling debris after drone interceptions.
In Qatar, air defences intercepted ballistic missiles in the early hours, with loud explosions heard across Doha before the threat level was lowered.
